title: Rerun the linear baseline with seed 2
rationale: cosine-seed-1 beats the baseline by +0.27 dB with one seed per arm, and the brief asks for 2 seeds. A second baseline seed shows how large seed noise is.
command: node ../../src/research-harness/cli.mjs run exec --experiment denoiser-samples --id linear-seed-2 --name "linear seed 2" --config configs/denoiser-linear-seed-2.json --metric-def psnr:maximize:dB --metric-def loss:minimize --dataset-id synth-shapes --dataset-revision v1 --split val --evaluator-revision psnr-1 -- node scripts/render_demo.mjs --schedule linear --seed 2

title: Run the cosine schedule with seed 2
rationale: finding-2: the gain is within seed noise, and the brief asks for 2 seeds per config. A second cosine seed is the cheapest way to tell.
command: node ../../src/research-harness/cli.mjs run exec --experiment denoiser-samples --id cosine-seed-2 --name "cosine seed 2" --config configs/denoiser-cosine-seed-2.json --metric-def psnr:maximize:dB --metric-def loss:minimize --dataset-id synth-shapes --dataset-revision v1 --split val --evaluator-revision psnr-1 -- node scripts/render_demo.mjs --schedule cosine --seed 2
